Struct CpuCore 

Source 
pub struct CpuCore(/* private fields */);
Expand description

Represents a dedicated CPU core for this environment.

Implementations§

Source§

impl CpuCore

Source

pub fn try_current() -> Option<Self>

Tries to return the current CPU core.

§Returns

If the current system thread is a dedicated SPDK CPU core, this function returns Some(c) where c is the current CPU core. Otherwise, this function returns None.

Source

pub fn current() -> Self

Returns the current CPU core.

§Panics

This function panics if the current system thread is not a on dedicated SPDK core.

Source

pub fn main() -> Self

Returns the main core for this environment.

Source

pub fn id(&self) -> u32

Returns the ID of this CPU core.

Source

pub fn numa_node(&self) -> NumaNode

Returns the NUMA node of this CPU core.

Source

pub fn siblings(&self) -> Option<CpuSet>

Returns a CpuSet with each SMT sibling core’s bit set to true.

If the specified core has no siblings, then only the specified core’s bit will be set. If the core has SMT siblings, then all siblings, including the specified core, will be set.

NOTE: The bits will be set for all SMY siblings regardless of whether they are part of the application’s core mask.

A CpuSet is only returned if SMT detection is enabled for the underlying platform. Otherwise, this method return None.
